rollback_or_stop_rule: Stop if the four-kind vocabulary cannot classify a real census movement without a fifth kind, or if any leaf field cannot be assigned to locator, judgment, review provenance, or identity. In either case the honest outcome is a refused derivation and a named gap, never a widened vocabulary that lets a locator move read as a retirement — which is the exact failure this record exists to make impossible. Never close this record by editing the withdrawn record, its artifact, or the certified predecessor.
